title: Archive Services / Regional Synchronisation Audit
summary: Routine audit of a regional archive node following a failed overnight synchronisation.
body:
A scheduled synchronisation between regional archive nodes failed during the 03:00 maintenance window.

No loss of primary records was confirmed.

The following conditions were noted during review:

- 17 records were present at the receiving node which were not present in the originating node.
- 4 records carried dates outside the receiving node's authorised retention period.
- 2 records referenced facilities not recognised by the regional registry.
- 1 record was returned with a valid checksum but an unreadable source header.

The receiving node was instructed to quarantine the affected records pending manual reconciliation.

No further action required at regional level.

Audit closed 324.03.19.
